build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.gpl: flight-authority::survey owns camera policy; old Bevy survey and native host consume it; shared bookmark labels remain game policy
ownership.mit: render-core/render-wgpu frames, geometry and shared device/queue unchanged

contract.site_reset: distance and free look reset; orbit preserved; ignored during vehicle preview/live flight
contract.precision: legacy f64 site north/east, cast to f32 matrix and orbit offset; not a quaternion replacement of that matrix
contract.polar_policy: finite orthogonal basis at exact poles instead of the old NaNs; invalid or non-unit up rejected
contract.native_projection: existing 0.9 rad vertical FOV, 1..1e8 m depth range; not Bevy projection parity
contract.native_controls: --site 0|1|2; HUD site buttons; F6 cycle; right-drag orbit; Shift-right-drag look; wheel zoom; Backquote reset; arrows yaw/zoom; HUD capture blocks gestures/shortcuts
contract.not_ported: celestial map camera/orbit UI, native network/fleet adoption and remaining graphics/UI/effects

measurement_boundary.latency: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/uploads/GPU completion; live flight includes full existing local physics demand; excludes setup, prestream, warmup and final readback; not game FPS or GPU-only time
measurement_boundary.terrain_comparison: new 5 km framing replaces old native 30 km elevated framing: no equal-workload terrain A/B claim
measurement_boundary.live_comparison: A/B/B/A against the exact navball baseline binary; unchanged camera/authority workload, async publication counts vary; no isolated controller cost or speedup claim

live_runs.conclusion: trajectory and final geometry preserved; medians overlap, no speedup or isolated adapter overhead claim

native_wayland.boundary: presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback or game FPS

legacy_bevy.environment: THESSA_AUTOBENCH=1 THESSA_AUTOBENCH_VIEW=surface THESSA_AUTOBENCH_SITE=1 THESSA_SCREENSHOT_PATH=IMAGE.png THESSA_SCREENSHOT_AT_S=6; not paused
legacy_bevy.limitations: missing sibling server binary: existing local simulation fallback; ALSA device warnings, no audio validation; different resolution/FOV/time/effects/HUD, not equal-scene parity

verification.regressions: original arithmetic differential; gesture/zoom/reset factors; invalid/polar inputs; site/flight isolation; HUD site reset without stale-distance overwrite; original eye placement across site/spin/distance; camera-relative ABI
verification.review_boundary: implementer inspection and deterministic numeric/GPU tests only, not independent blind visual preference or acceptance

limitations: Existing terrain seams/LOD defects, flat native sky and material/effects parity remain unresolved; captures are not visual acceptance.
No persistent conforming GPU bisector pool, FastRT acceleration structures or device-loss recovery is established by this slice.
Celestial map camera, server/fleet presentation, remaining UI/assists/assets and effects remain migration work.
